subject.title: fix(cli-runner): drop volatile systemPromptHash from claude-cli live fingerprint

question: Should Claude CLI live-session reuse treat every stable prompt-component change as an invalidation, and if so which preparation-owned fingerprint fields are the canonical contract after current-main session changes?
rationale: The patch removes one identity dimension, but the safe replacement boundary depends on the intended session-reuse policy across primary, follow-up, heartbeat, and group-channel prompt assembly paths.

options.title: Keep stable invalidation
options.body: Preserve invalidation for every stable prompt component, while excluding only identified per-turn metadata at the prompt-preparation owner.

options.title: Relax prompt identity broadly
options.body: Allow reuse across stable prompt changes and explicitly document the semantic and security implications for live Claude sessions.

recommendation.title: Keep stable invalidation
recommendation.body: Preserve invalidation for every stable prompt component, while excluding only identified per-turn metadata at the prompt-preparation owner.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent open work directly changes the static prompt-hash construction that defines the requested policy boundary.
